'''Glynis Tor''' was a [[Dark side adept/Legends|Dark Side Adept]] serving [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]]. At some point during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Tor attempted to exploit the contents of his master's hoard against his enemies.<ref name="FFCA" />
